question: How do Liquity v2 (user-set interest rates, rate-ordered redemption), Reserve (basket RTokens with staked-RSR first loss) and Mento (reserve-backed FX stables) price and bear risk in pooled collateral?

frame.comparator: a Tidepool pool pricing its own credit

findings.finding: Borrowers set their own annual interest rate on each Trove, within MIN_ANNUAL_INTEREST_RATE 0.5 percent and MAX_ANNUAL_INTEREST_RATE 250 percent; changing it earlier than INTEREST_RATE_ADJ_COOLDOWN (7 days) after the last change costs an upfront fee of UPFRONT_INTEREST_PERIOD (7 days) of interest at the system average rate.

Redemption: redeemCollateral swaps BOLD for collateral from the Troves with the lowest interest rates first (SortedTroves ordered by rate); redemption fee floor REDEMPTION_FEE_FLOOR 0.5 percent; base rate decays with a 6-hour half-life (REDEMPTION_MINUTE_DECAY_FACTOR); initial base rate 100 percent so no redemptions unless BOLD depegs below 0.95. A low-rate borrower is therefore the first to be redeemed against: the rate is a price paid for redemption protection.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Splits the BOLD redemption according to the redemption routing logic

findings.finding: Interest split: SP_YIELD_SPLIT = 75 percent of minted interest goes to the Stability Pool and the rest to a yield router for DEX LP incentives (a mock contract in the repository). Interest can be delegated: setInterestIndividualDelegate lets a delegate adjust a Trove's rate within [min, max]; batch managers set one rate for a batch of Troves and charge an annual fee up to 10 percent (MAX_ANNUAL_BATCH_MANAGEMENT_FEE).

Collateral-branch shutdown on severe price collapse or oracle failure freezes borrower operations except closing, freezes interest accrual and enables urgent redemptions with a 2 percent bonus (URGENT_REDEMPTION_BONUS). Zombie Troves: redemptions leave Troves open and flag those below MIN_DEBT (2,000 BOLD). Last commit in clone 2026-09-26.

An RToken is an ERC-20 for a basket of multi-unit value (USD, ETH, other units with collateral). Components: Main, AssetRegistry, BasketHandler, BackingManager (holds collateral, rebalances through Broker trades when undercollateralized), Broker (dutch auctions, Gnosis EasyAuction batch fallback), Distributor, Furnace (melts RTokens slowly to pay yield to holders), StRSR (staked RSR, slashed on seizure), RToken, RevenueTrader.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Furnace: This contract is responsible for melting RTokens, distributing yield to RToken holders.

findings.finding: Loss ordering: the protocol first trades to restore backing, then seizes staked RSR (the overcollateralization layer), and only then "takes a haircut" by reducing RToken.basketsNeeded() to current holdings so the RToken becomes collateralized by definition. StRSR warns that when all RSR is seized balances reset to zero.

Audits in repo: Ackee, Certora (FixLib), Code4rena releases 2.1.0, 3.0.0 (core and collaterals), 4.0.0, Halborn, Oak Security 2026-03-12 (Reserve Updates). Deployed as immutable implementations; users deploy proxies through a Deployer. Last commit in clone 2026-09-23.

Mento V3 is described as "A decentralized exchange (DEX) for onchain foreign exchange (FX)" using Fixed-Price Market Makers that quote an oracle rate instead of deriving price from reserves; "Today, Chainlink is the only oracle source used in Mento V3". USDm and EURm are backed by the Reserve, other stables such as GBPm by collateralized debt positions.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Today, Chainlink is the only oracle source used in Mento V3.
